remote_interaction.help.1: 1. Craft 2 receivers using 4 iron ingots, 2 copper ingots, 2 redstone dust and 1 quartz.
remote_interaction.help.2: 2. Hold a receiver and right-click a supported block. Survival consumes one; Creative does not.
remote_interaction.help.3: 3. Press R or type /ri, then click Activate. Rebind the key under Options > Controls.
remote_interaction.help.4: Supports buttons, levers, doors, trapdoors, fence gates, repeaters, comparators, note blocks, bells and daylight detectors. Excludes iron doors/trapdoors and containers.
remote_interaction.help.5: Only your receivers are listed. Targets must be in loaded chunks in your current dimension. There is no distance limit.
remote_interaction.help.6: Select a name to rename or recover. Missing blocks still allow recovery. Cyan receiver markers are visible only to you. Install the mod on the server too.
